title: Sports Betting in Canada Slows – Will NFL Season Spark a Comeback?
excerpt: Canadian sports betting has cooled in recent months. Could the new NFL season reignite handle at the country’s top sportsbooks?
author: Jane Williams
bodyHtml:
It’s becoming increasingly evident that sports betting in Canada has experienced a notable decline in recent months, as the quieter summer sports calendar takes its toll on handle across the country.

With the NFL season approaching, operators are betting on a strong autumn rebound. Football historically drives some of the biggest wagering volumes of the year, and the top Canadian sportsbooks are already rolling out enhanced odds and welcome offers to capture new bettors.
